summary.text: Jim Caron is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Hillsborough 13, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Caron previously ran for the New Hampshire House of Representatives in 2010 (Hillsborough 26) and 2012 (Hillsborough 37), and was not elected either time.
